# MSI notebook warranty extension — SRC-0261

## Sources

- https://euservice.msi.com/nl/warranty-extension/nl/
- https://www.coolblue.be/nl/product/944001/msi-1-year-warranty-extension-service-for-notebooks.html

## Evidence

MSI's German service portal lists a one-year notebook extension at €119 and two years at €249. It begins after the factory warranty, covers failures under normal use, includes direct MSI support, priority repair, two-way shipping and pickup/return, and excludes the battery/accessories, accidental damage, unauthorized repair and software problems. The service requires a German/same-country purchase and cannot be assigned to a Belgian notebook transaction.

Coolblue Belgium lists MSI service code `957-1XXXXE-073` for extending Raider notebooks from two to three years, but its own €155 offer is unavailable. The earlier €4281.04 and €3818 totals remain retracted because their €119 German price is invalid. A later Belgian LASystems listing for the same service code supplies a valid €162.62 route; see `SRC-0282`.
